_comment_local_config: Machine configuration for this pipeline root (the folder TLS_PIPELINE points at). Read-only at runtime. Which bundle each DCC uses is decided by the remote config.json, not here.
_comment_remote_repository: Folder holding the pipeline bundles and the studio config.json. Usually a network drive. A web URL is inferred from the value and rejected until web repositories are supported. Relative paths resolve against this file's folder, not the working directory.
_comment_bundle_repository: Local folder bundles are copied to, at <bundle_repository>/hosts/<host>/<bundle_version>. Defaults to ./bundles.
